name: dogfood-deno-deploy-geo-app
description: Dogfood app v1.24-4 — a Deno Fresh app on Deno Deploy that exercises the geo-replicated axis (Deno KV strong consistency + multi-region write + eventual consistency observation) + edge-kv axis (read-your-writes + range query) + cron-trigger axis (Deno Deploy Cron scheduled + queue trigger + 24h retention purge) end-to-end. Drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Deno Deploy sandbox + DENO_DEPLOY_KEY env-gate) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-lab/edge v0.2 8 axis semantics) so behavioural fidelity feeds the release gate 7 axis.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/edge -F @kiwa-lab/core -F @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
